forum.title: STP80NF55-06 MARKING is not same datasheet
forum.best_answer_content:
Welcome ​@NOTE TEAM, to the community!

The [datasheet](https://www.st.com/resource/en/datasheet/stp80nf55-06.pdf) in rev. 8 was updated in October 2006, which means the marking code may well have been adjusted. In this case, **P80NF55@** is indeed the currently correct marking for [STP80NF55-06](https://www.st.com/en/power-transistors/stp80nf55-06.html).

Regards

/Peter
